a method was developed to quantitate residues of the four ionophores in beef liver tissue.

the LC method with fluorometric detector developed in this research is a sensitive and reliable method for quantitating residues of monensin (M), salinomycins (SM), and narasin in beef liver.

the development of a rapid, sensitive, accurate, and specific method for the determination of residues of ionophores in liver tissue.
the development of a rapid and sensitive analytical method that can be used to quantitate residues of monensin and 3 other ionophore compounds in liver tissue.

the development and validation of a liquid chromatographic method with fluorometric (LC/FLD) detection for the determination of multiresidues of ionophore antibiotics, monensin sodium, salinomycins, narasin sodium and lasalocids, in beef liver.
